matching: same fold-local train mean/SD 5x5 bins, global derangement, set size and overlap preserved; train finite coverage >=90%
models: exact parent 8D score and balanced logistic classifier, C=[0.1,1,10]; no pathways/prompts/architectures modified
true_predictions: reuse independently validated parent R1 Stage OOF; prove true score identity before each split
primary_summary: rank of the true 3-seed mean OOF BA among 99 matched random realizations; finite benchmark exceedance=(1+count_random_ge_true)/100
robustness_rule: true mean exceeds the 95th percentile of matched random mean OOF BA, benchmark exceedance <=0.05, and true BA exceeds 95th percentile in each split seed
statistical_scope: conditional matched-gene benchmark on the discovery cohort; Stage selected after original discovery; not independent validation or a causal p-value
bootstrap: 2000 paired class-stratified patients, shared resamples across seeds; true correctness minus mean random-realization correctness; conditional 95% interval
source_audit: original file missing tokens, exact rectangular mask, parser/alignment equivalence, official pinned upstream numeric comparison, cancer type and tissue-source associations; no outcome-driven batch correction
data_repair: none; retain existing matrices and folds; distinguish exact upstream proof from inferred platform cause
publication: code and aggregate reports only; upstream raw data, IDs and OOF remain server-private
